notes: Overlay sources are independent MapLibre sources/layers. They are not merged into the active PMTiles basemap.

overlays.name: USGS Topo
overlays.description: Online USGS National Map topographic raster overlay. Requires internet unless a future cache/mirror is configured.

overlays.name: Local GeoJSON Overlay
overlays.description: Drop custom.geojson into /data/oiab/maps/overlays and rescan to use this offline vector overlay.

overlays.name: Local PMTiles Vector Overlay
overlays.description: Drop custom-overlay.pmtiles into /data/oiab/maps/overlays and configure its source layer before enabling.
